doc.title: Slope and intercept
doc.sheet:
concept slope: m
  say how far y rises for one step to the right in x
  label above
  scrub -3 .. 3 step 0.5 = 1.5
  limit -2 .. 2
concept intercept: b
  say where the line crosses the y axis, when x is 0
  brace below
  slider -4 .. 4 step 0.5 = 1
plot y over x from -5 to 5
  y from -8 to 8
  mark slope rise x = 1
  mark intercept intercept
doc.prose: The line rises by its [slope](slope) for each step to the right, and crosses the y axis at the [intercept](intercept). Drag the slope sideways, or slide the intercept.

doc.title: One step of gradient descent
doc.sheet:
concept next: w_{k+1}
  name next weight
  say where this update moves the weight
  label below next weight
concept current: w_k
  name current weight
  say the weight before this step
  slider 0 .. 6 step 0.1 = 1.2
concept stepsize: \alpha
  name step size
  say how far one update moves
  scrub 0.1 .. 2.5 step 0.1 = 0.8
  tint
concept gradient: \nabla f(w_k)
  name gradient
  say the slope of the loss at the current weight
  brace below gradient
plot f over w from 0 to 6
  mark current point w = w_k
  mark next point w = w_{k+1}
doc.prose: Start at the [current weight](current), find the [gradient](gradient) of the loss there, and move against it by the [step size](stepsize) to reach the [next weight](next). Make the step size large and watch the next weight jump past the lowest point.

label: The real part of a complex number

doc.title: The real part of a complex number
doc.sheet:
concept real: a
  name real part
  say the part of z on the real axis
concept imaginary: bi
  name imaginary part
  say the part of z on the imaginary axis
concept conjugate: \bar{z}
  name conjugate
  say z with the sign of its imaginary part flipped
  label below conjugate
step Start from the definition
  formula 1
step Write z and its conjugate in parts
  formula 2
step Collect the terms
  formula 3
  strike imaginary
step The imaginary parts cancel
  formula 4
  focus real
doc.prose: Adding z to its [conjugate](conjugate) cancels the [imaginary part](imaginary) and doubles the [real part](real). Press Play to watch it happen, or step through by hand.

doc.title: Compound interest
doc.sheet:
concept principal: P
  say the money put in at the start
  edit 1000
concept rate: r
  name yearly rate
  say the interest rate for one year, as a fraction
  slider 0 .. 0.2 step 0.01 = 0.05
concept years: t
  say how long the money grows
  scrub 0 .. 40 step 1 = 10
concept growth: \left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{t n}
  name growth factor
  say how many times over the money multiplies
  border
hidden n 1 .. 365 step 1 = 12 times it compounds each year
plot A over t from 0 to 40
  mark years point t = t
doc.prose: Put in a [principal](principal) and let it grow at a [yearly rate](rate) for some [years](years). The [growth factor](growth) multiplies the principal. Type a new principal into its box.

doc.title: Pythagoras
doc.sheet:
concept hypotenuse: c
  say the side across from the right angle
  label above
  pointer
concept sidea: a
  name side a
  slider 1 .. 12 step 1 = 3
concept sideb: b
  name side b
  slider 1 .. 12 step 1 = 4
concept squares: a^2 + b^2
  name sum of the squares
  say the area of the two smaller squares together
  border
doc.prose: The square on the [hypotenuse](hypotenuse) equals the [sum of the squares](squares) on [side a](sidea) and [side b](sideb). Hover the hypotenuse to see its length.

doc.title: Area of a rectangle
doc.sheet:
concept length: \ell
  unit cm
  label above
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 4
concept width: w
  unit cm
  label above
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 3
concept area: A
  say the space inside the rectangle, in square units
  label below
doc.prose: The [area](area) is the [length](length) times the [width](width). Slide them and watch it change.

doc.title: Area of a triangle
doc.sheet:
concept base: b
  unit cm
  say the side the triangle stands on
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 6
concept height: h
  unit cm
  say how tall the triangle is, straight up from its base
  label above
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 4
concept area: A
  say the space inside the triangle, in square units
  label below
doc.prose: Half the [base](base) times the [height](height) gives the [area](area).

doc.title: Volume of a box
doc.sheet:
concept length: \ell
  unit cm
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 5
concept width: w
  unit cm
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 3
concept height: h
  unit cm
  slider 1 .. 10 step 1 = 2
concept volume: V
  say how many unit cubes fill the box
  label below
doc.prose: The [volume](volume) is the [length](length) times the [width](width) times the [height](height).

doc.title: Distance at a steady speed
doc.sheet:
concept speed: r
  unit km/h
  label above
  slider 5 .. 80 step 5 = 65
concept time: t
  unit h
  label above
  scrub 0 .. 10 step 1 = 2
concept distance: d
  unit km
  say how far you go
  label below
plot d over t from 0 to 10
  y from 0 to 800
  mark time point t = t
doc.prose: Going at a steady [speed](speed), the [distance](distance) grows with the [time](time). Drag the time and watch the point move.

label: Volume and outside of a cube

doc.title: Volume and outside of a cube
doc.sheet:
concept side: s
  unit cm
  label above
  slider 0.5 .. 5 step 0.5 = 0.5
concept volume: V
  say how many unit cubes fill the cube
concept outside: A
  name outside area
  say the area of all six faces together
doc.prose: One [side](side) gives both the [volume](volume) and the [outside area](outside).

doc.title: Sharing a product
doc.sheet:
concept three: 3
  name the 3s
concept x: x
  name number in the bracket
step 3 groups of (2 + x)
  formula 1
step Share the 3 with each part
  formula 2
  focus three
step Work out 3 times 2
  formula 3
doc.prose: The [3](three) multiplies each part inside the bracket. Press Play.
